rules.start: explicit boss button; prepare team outside battle
rules.win: all victory-counting enemies dead before time limit
rules.lose: all four party members dead or 40000ms timeout (D-066); main death alone does not lose
rules.new_attempt: fresh full party HP/SP, no previous transient buffs, new battle seed; unchanged build

reference_teams.budget_policy: equal level/manual points/paid skill resources/Common tier gear; no specific card required
same total resource budget, classes can branch only when level permits

balance_reference_gear: Common highest enabled tier <= actor level; Refine0 below20, Refine3 at20..39, Refine5 at40..70; Enchant0/no cards. Same paid skill/stat resource budgets across alternatives.
